image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle view of a wooden plank or beam moving along a conveyor system in an industrial setting. The wood has a light tan color with visible grain and some red markings. In the background, there are blurred structural elements including dark metal beams, other wooden planks, and what appears to be part of a sawmill mechanism. The lighting is artificial and somewhat dim, typical of an indoor factory environment.
